evidence: Clear module separation by domain (clienttrader, follower, webtrader, utils, config, miniqmt)
Shared core abstraction layers (IClientTrader, IGridStrategy, IRefreshStrategy, BaseFollower, WebTrader)
Bidirectional imports within the main package (e.g., clienttrader imports from grid_strategies, utils, config)
No service boundaries or inter-service communication patterns (e.g., no RPC, message queues, or REST service endpoints between modules)
Multiple trader implementations (GF, GJ, HT, etc.) follow common inheritance from BaseLoginClientTrader
Follower and Trader patterns are closely coupled within same package
risks: Some modules (e.g., clienttrader, follower) have high coupling through shared utilities and config
WebTrader and ClientTrader branches show partial overlap but lack strict separation of concerns
No explicit ports/adapters boundary (violating hexagonal intent despite some adapter-like patterns)
